|errata_history={{Card errata/Coruscant: The Works}}
This is the errata version PC-E1 of [[Coruscant: The Works]] (version 2 of 2). The image here is the Players Committee card image published 21 April 2022. The current text is [[Coruscant: The Works (Errata)]] (PC-E2). Each version below is quoted in full with its dated source. Every published image that differs visibly from the one before is a version (Bill, 12 November 2026). (ALT-PNG, 13 Nov 2026: the later card-size copies of this image are no longer listed as separate versions; see the version list.)
* '''Original''' ([[Coruscant: The Works]]): Virtual Set 16 release; card image first published 3 September 2021<ref name="img-2021-09-03-1">Players Committee card image <code>Virtual16-Dark/large/coruscanttheworks.gif</code> as published 3 September 2021: [https://github.com/swccgpc/holotable/blob/b4a011ace2799d9e188578c4043193ff94a7a06c/Images-HT/starwars/Virtual16-Dark/large/coruscanttheworks.gif holotable commit b4a011a] (the PC's card-image repository, which serves res.starwarsccg.org/cards).</ref>: “Dark: May deploy non-[Theed Palace] Sidious here from Reserve Deck; reshuffle. Light: If opponent's [Special Edition] objective on table, gains one [Light Side] icon and Force drain +2 here.”
* '''PC-E1''' (this page): '''First published 20 April 2022''' as the high-resolution PNG <code>Images-HT/starwars/Virtual16-Dark/hires/coruscanttheworks.png</code> ([https://github.com/swccgpc/holotable/commit/2640d508acff17553640735ee7a15ad93fa78a65 commit 2640d50]); the card-size image cited next is a later copy of the same image (a version is dated by its first publication in any format; ALT-PNG, 13 Nov 2026). Card image published 21 April 2022<ref name="img-2022-04-21-1">Players Committee card image <code>Virtual16-Dark/large/coruscanttheworks.gif</code> as published 21 April 2022: [https://github.com/swccgpc/holotable/blob/3f7288d580f892a638c6e3b78ca43474ade7756a/Images-HT/starwars/Virtual16-Dark/large/coruscanttheworks.gif holotable commit 3f7288d] (the PC's card-image repository, which serves res.starwarsccg.org/cards).</ref>: “Dark: May deploy non-[Theed Palace] Sidious here from Reserve Deck; reshuffle. If your [Special Edition] objective on table, gains one [Light Side] icon and opponent's Force drains are +2 here. Light: -” '''What changed:''' Light Side text “If opponent's [Special Edition] objective on table, gains one [Light Side] icon and Force drain +2 here.” became “-”. Dark Side text “May deploy non-[Theed Palace] Sidious here from Reserve Deck; reshuffle.” became “May deploy non-[Theed Palace] Sidious here from Reserve Deck; reshuffle. If your [Special Edition] objective on table, gains one [Light Side] icon and opponent's Force drains are +2 here.”. This image was first published on 20 April 2022 as the high-resolution PNG <code>Images-HT/starwars/Virtual16-Dark/hires/coruscanttheworks.png</code> ([https://github.com/swccgpc/holotable/commit/2640d508acff17553640735ee7a15ad93fa78a65 commit 2640d50]); the card-size GIF uploaded 11 June 2022 ([https://github.com/swccgpc/holotable/commit/6894629d2267392808e0be34eb4aaa7686eced2c commit 6894629], earlier listed as its own version, PC-E2) is a later copy of the same image in another format, so it is not a new version (a version is one distinct image, dated when it was first published in any format; ALT-PNG, 13 Nov 2026).
